desc:
🚔 Welcome to Work at a Police Station! 🚔

Step into the role of a police officer & help keep the MapleWood Police Station running!

🖥️ Assist visitors at the front desk
📦 Process, log, and store evidence
☎️ Answer incoming 911 calls
🚔 Photograph, fingerprint, log, search, and book suspects
🧪 Process cases in the Forensics Lab
⚖️ Assist with tasks in the Lawyers Office
👜 Bag and prepare warbags for officers
🚨 Respond to fire & medical emergencies
💰 Earn Cash and XP as you complete duties
⚡ Complete many other tasks!

Enjoying the game? Favourite us ⭐ and support us with a thumbs up! 👍
